name: Fossil Group, Inc.
addedReason: premarket mover on a Q3 2026 earnings beat and raised FY2026 revenue outlook

pe.note: Company has a history of net losses (Q3 2025 net loss $39.9M / -$0.76 per diluted share); trailing P/E not meaningful. Q3 2026 result unconfirmed — see conflicts.

eps.note: Only unverified third-party figures located (~$10.6M net loss); per-share figure not confirmed against a primary source

revenue.note: Third-party aggregator (Panabee) cites ~$209.7M, down ~4.9% YoY, but this figure is unverified — see conflicts

price.note: This is the pre-earnings 1-year-high close cited by Benzinga; no reliable post-earnings (Nov 11+) quote was located.

catalysts.headline: Fossil Group management scheduled to present at the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference
Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 results described as an earnings beat and raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to approximately $990M (up from a prior ~$954-974M range)
catalysts.impact: Premarket move reported between +20.2% and +25.7% across aggregators

catalysts.headline: Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 results after market close; a third-party aggregator (unverified) cites revenue of ~$209.7M (down ~4.9% YoY), gross margin of 62.4% (+490bps), and a net loss of ~$10.6M
catalysts.impact: Low-confidence — the primary press release was not located, and this aggregator's stated year-ago comparison does not match Fossil's own official Q3 2025 release

catalysts.headline: FOSL closed at a 1-year high of $8.06 the session before its Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.impact: Stock had rallied into the print; pre-earnings consensus called for a swing to a $0.03 EPS profit on ~$247.2M revenue

conflicts: Earnings date given differently across sources: company's own Oct 20 announcement and Benzinga say after-close on 2026-11-10; EarningsWhispers lists 2026-11-09; Yahoo Finance's estimate shows 2026-11-12.

Q3 2026 financial results are not corroborated by a primary source in this research pass: the only figures found (Panabee, a third-party aggregator) state a prior-year (Q3 2025) net loss of $2.3M, which directly conflicts with Fossil's own official Q3 2025 release (net loss $39.9M / -$0.76 per diluted share on $270.2M revenue). Because of this internal inconsistency, the Q3 2026 figures from that same source (~$209.7M revenue, ~$10.6M net loss) are flagged as unverified and are not reported as established fact.

Pre-earnings consensus (profit of ~$0.03/share on ~$247.2M revenue) versus the unverified post-print figures above would represent a large miss, but this cannot be confirmed without the primary release.
notes: Could not locate Fossil Group's official Q3 2026 press release or 8-K in this research pass; strongly recommend pulling it directly from fossilgroup.com/investor-relations or SEC EDGAR before reporting specific Q3 2026 revenue/EPS/price-reaction figures.
